summary: The Void is the collapsed nexus of time, space, and planar resonance. It exists outside the ordered cosmology, where eras overlap, realities fracture, and echoes of existence drift without anchor.
history: The Void formed when temporal resonance collapsed during the first planar war.
Fragments of past and future planes drift into the Void.
Zebuxoruk was imprisoned here to prevent cosmic destabilization.
The Void periodically expands and contracts, altering planar connections.
